faq.q: Is Burke Mountain a neighbourhood or a whole planning area?
faq.a: Both — it is a single board sub-area of Coquitlam and a large City planning area: the City states three neighbourhood plans (Hyde Creek, Smiling Creek and Partington Creek) guide the growth built to date, with the Northwest Burke Vision (adopted July 17, 2017, ~400 hectares) guiding the next phase toward Pinecone Burke Provincial Park.

faq.q: What is the Partington Creek wildlife corridor?
faq.a: A City of Coquitlam initiative securing a wildlife corridor along Partington Creek — about 50 metres wide, expanding to a 100-metre buffer at a wildlife hot spot — connecting Pinecone Burke Provincial Park, Minnekhada Regional Park and surrounding green spaces, with lands transferred to City ownership and designated as parkland.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Burke Mountain?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Burke Mountain?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
